design_system.visual_theme: Electric Mega-Fest: Deep void obsidian background with hyper-vibrant neon glow highlights, kinetic typography, crisp 1px borders, and tactile glass cards for event schedules & lineups.

rules.overline: text-xs font-mono tracking-[0.25em] uppercase text-cyan-400 font-semibold

accessibility_guidelines.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant text contrast ratios (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
accessibility_guidelines.data_testids: Every CTA, filter tab, video modal trigger, admin media row, image card, schedule selector, and form control MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-register-btn', data-testid='schedule-day-tab-1', data-testid='media-item-delete-btn')
accessibility_guidelines.keyboard_nav: Full tab and enter/space trigger support on interactive cards and lightbox dialogs
accessibility_guidelines.reduced_motion: Respect @media (prefers-reduced-motion) by gracefully disabling glow pulsing and aggressive transforms

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Hybrid Fullstack Execution: Maintain Vite/React 19 frontend (/frontend) while synchronizing dynamic gallery & video data models in FastAPI backend (/backend/routers/media.py & /backend/models/media.py) AND keeping CodeIgniter package / views updated.

2. Media CMS Dynamic Contract: Provide dynamic API endpoints GET /api/media (public active items with filters), POST /api/media (admin create), PUT /api/media/{id} (admin update order/caption/active status), DELETE /api/media/{id} (admin remove).
3. Video Support: Handle both direct image uploads / URLs and embedded video providers (YouTube, Vimeo, MP4 URLs) with automatic thumbnail parsing and embedded responsive player.

4. Theme & Aesthetic: Implement dark mode by default using Deep Obsidian (#090A0F) with hyper-energetic Neon Pink (#FF0055), Cyber Cyan (#00F0FF), and Amber (#FFB800) accents. Avoid generic SaaS blue or boring plain cards.

5. Testing & Verification: Ensure all interactive triggers have kebab-case data-testid attributes. Test public landing, gallery lightbox, video playback modal, admin media CRUD, and scanner flows before completion.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.do_not_center_app: Avoid app-wide text-align: center; maintain structured asymmetric alignment with generous spacing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not use 'transition: all'; specify transition-transform, transition-opacity, transition-colors individually.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.font_policy: Import Space Grotesk Variable for headers, DM Sans Variable for body, JetBrains Mono Variable for tags/monospaced stats. Never use Inter for headers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_usage: Use sonner for instant toast feedback upon pass scan, registration submit, or media item update.
